RemediationCommand: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -Name ScreenSaveActive -Value "1" -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -Name ScreenSaveTimeOut -Value "600" -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -Name SCRNSAVE.EXE -Value "C:\Windows\System32\ssText3d.scr" -Force
CheckCommand: $active = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ScreenSaveActive; $timeout = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ScreenSaveTimeOut; $scr = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)."SCRNSAVE.EXE"; (($active -eq "1") -and ($timeout -eq "600") -and ($scr -like "*ssText3d.scr*")).ToString()
Title: 화면보호기 설정
Description: 화면보호기 활성화 설정 (3차원 텍스트, 대기 시간 10분/600초)
